description: This file is the main HTML source for a web-based database viewer interface, containing markup, styles, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic interaction with databases, tables, and data display.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Triggers reloading of the database list with a spinning refresh button.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a specific database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from the data array and inserts it into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls and large objects or strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncate it.
